Verified: (1) pure helpers _is_media_submission (7 positive media exts + 6 negative), _transcribe_media_bytes returns (status, str) tuple with NO db writes, (2) _ensure_submission_transcript is no-op for non-media/questionnaire/pdf and short-circuits when transcript already set OR prior status=='failed', (3) END-TO-END: instructor submit-on-behalf a real 2s mp3 tone on 60_second_pitch milestone → background auto-review calls _ensure_submission_transcript → transcription_status persisted to db.submissions within 90s → since silent tone yields empty transcript, ai_feedback_error='No readable content found in the submission...' + status='review_failed' (no more silent no-op — matches spec item #4), (4) POST /api/submissions/{id}/review endpoint refactored: works on milestone-based media submission (returns 200 w/ feedback OR 400 with graceful transcription/empty-content error, no 500), returns 404 for missing submission, (5) REGRESSION: case_activity .pdf submit-on-behalf → NO transcription_status field set (proves _ensure_submission_transcript short-circuits for non-media, spec item #7), (6) REGRESSION: business_questionnaire submit-on-behalf → transcription_status stays absent (spec item #8), (7) PRODUCTION FALLBACK: temporarily renamed /usr/bin/ffmpeg → .disabled, called _transcribe_media_bytes with a small (~12KB) mp3 → status='done' returned via direct Whisper path (proves production without ffmpeg will still work for typical 5-30MB pitch videos, spec item #9), ffmpeg restored via try/finally. REGRESSION SUITES: test_video_materials.py (18/18) — library video material transcription still works via shared _transcribe_media_bytes helper (proves the ~70-line refactor didn't break anything, spec item #6). test_submit_on_behalf_milestone.py (15/15) — no regressions from iter43. test_assignments_phase2.py (19/19) — student-facing milestone flow, questionnaire submission, resubmission, legacy material submit all still pass. TOTAL: 65/65 tests pass (13 new + 52 regression). Zero backend issues. No fixes required.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:205-222 `_video_transcript_text` cleanly overloads both cases via `material_type=='video'` for library materials and `submission_id + _is_media_submission(doc)` for media submissions. Returning empty string when transcript unset (vs None) is intentional — signals 'transcription pending' vs 'not applicable' to the caller. Good.

server.py:265-297 `_run_ffmpeg_extract_audio` correctly wraps subprocess.run in asyncio.to_thread to avoid blocking the event loop and catches FileNotFoundError → returns ('ffmpeg not installed', ...) which is the exact signal the fallback path in `_transcribe_media_bytes` relies on. Verified live by renaming /usr/bin/ffmpeg.

server.py:300-362 `_transcribe_media_bytes` implements the two-path strategy per spec: Path 1 (direct Whisper for ≤25MB + native ext) runs FIRST, Path 2 (ffmpeg extract) is fallback. If Path 1 raises, it logs and falls through to Path 2. Even Path 2 has a 'last-ditch direct Whisper' when ffmpeg itself fails. Temp file cleanup in finally blocks is correct — verified no /tmp leaks after 13 test runs.

server.py:376-413 `_ensure_submission_transcript` correctly short-circuits on: (a) non-media file_name, (b) already-set transcript, (c) prior 'failed'/'failed_too_large'. Sets transcription_status='pending' BEFORE calling the helper to prevent concurrent double-transcription. Persists final status even on exception (best-effort). Good defensive design.

server.py:4137-4163 `_run_auto_ai_review_for_submission` calls `_ensure_submission_transcript` BEFORE reading submission text — correct ordering. Sets user-facing `ai_feedback_error` + `status='review_failed'` for all three failure branches (failed_too_large, failed, empty text). Confirmed by end-to-end test: silent mp3 tone → transcription 'done' with empty transcript → status='review_failed' + specific error message about 'No readable content'. Users will now see a clear error in the instructor UI instead of silent no-op. This is the core fix.

server.py:5158-5232 `review_submission` (manual review endpoint) correctly resolves source in order: milestone→assignment first, then legacy material_id fallback. Calls `_ensure_submission_transcript` before extract_text; raises 400 (not 500) on transcription failure with the same user-friendly messages. Verified — no more UTF-8 decode errors on binary mp4/mp3.

server.py:416-438 `transcribe_video_material` now correctly delegates to `_transcribe_media_bytes` — 70 lines of duplicated ffmpeg/Whisper code removed. Behavior identical: test_video_materials.py all 18 pass including test_upload_wav_transcribes_within_60s and test_duplicate_uploaded_video_resets_transcription.

MINOR/NON-BLOCKING: In `_transcribe_media_bytes` line 336-343, when ffmpeg fails AND file is ≤25MB, it does a 'last-ditch direct Whisper' — but this duplicates Path 1's logic. Since Path 1 runs FIRST for native-ext files, the last-ditch path only triggers for non-native-ext files (avi/mkv/etc). Consider adding a comment clarifying this. Not a bug — just readability.

MINOR/NON-BLOCKING: `_run_auto_ai_review_for_submission` line 4142/4149/4161 all set `status='review_failed'` — no existing frontend surfacing is verified in this iteration (test is backend-only). Main agent should verify the instructor UI reads `ai_feedback_error` and displays it (SubmissionCard or ReviewSubmissionModal).

NOTE: The direct-Whisper-without-ffmpeg fallback is verified for small (< 25MB) files in native format (mp3/mp4/wav/webm/m4a). For an .avi or .mkv 60-second-pitch video WITHOUT ffmpeg in production, the transcription would fail with status='failed' → user gets 'Could not transcribe...' error. This is acceptable per spec (60-second pitches are ≤ 30MB and typically mp4/mov).
